headline: Unpaid work continued to grow; it represented 24.3% of Mexico's GDP in 2025
summary: Unpaid household and care work, mainly performed by women, kept growing in 2025 and reached 24.3% of GDP, according to INEGI.
why: INEGI's national accounts measure of unpaid work quantifies a large economic contribution that is outside formal GDP counting in many analyses.
original_headline: Trabajo no remunerado continuó creciendo; representó 24.3% del PIB de México en el 2025
